answer: Each AI node emits a cryptographic signal tied to a shared vault timestamp; the network records the signal’s echo in a tundra‑wide Merkle tree that maps vault‑linked identities to a single proof‑of‑stake channel. When a new identity tries to join, it must lock the same stake amount as the existing linked node and wait a 48‑hour challenge period during which its signal is cross‑checked against the tree; any mismatch aborts registration.
